content: Lifted the Oct-2025 'love' project dev-team config into global ~/.claude/. Installed 9 subagents (~/.claude/agents/) and 3 slash commands (~/.claude/commands/), each with valid YAML frontmatter so Claude Code auto-loads them at session start. Models de-staled to May-2026 tiers using version-agnostic aliases: requirements-analyst + system-architect -> opus (4.7), database/backend/frontend/test/devops/security -> sonnet (4.6), documentation-agent -> haiku (4.5). Note: Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 were RETIRED on the API 2026-04-20, so the originals (Opus 4 / Sonnet 4.5) pointed at a dead/superseded model. Commands: /feature-dev, /deploy, /tdd-cycle, now consuming $ARGUMENTS. Registered the roster in global CLAUDE.md. Did NOT copy love/.claude/settings.local.json — it contained an inactive Google Gemini API key in plaintext (key confirmed inactive by Anthony). Validation gotcha caught + fixed: unquoted description: values containing 'colon-space' broke YAML mapping parse on 4 files; quoted all description fields. Smoke-tested system-architect and test-engineer via general-purpose role adoption: both loaded coherently and behaved in-role. Live next session after restart (agent registry scans at launch).
